avis.titre: Best cleanser I've ever tried for my skin
avis.texte: I have oily acne prone skin. I have struggled with adult acne since my 20s. I have tried all the things and eventually got a regimen that kept everything stable. But now in my 30s, my skin has become more sensitive, still breakout prone, and dull/discolored from post inflammatory hyperpigmentation. I stumbled upon Rosen and really connected with the founder as a fellow black woman. I tried this cleanser, spot treatment, and the serum. To say I have been wowed is an understatement. I didn't think possible but my skin has been bumped to the next level. Appeared brighter after a few days of use, more glowy and smooth. Best of all! No irritation! I am so thrilled to continue to support this brand with the amazing results I'm seeing so far. Will continue to repurchase here on out! Go Rosen!

I thought the kojic acid and honey combination would be great for my skin. Honey is known for its antibacterial properties, however, the product is very oily and caused me to have painful breakouts! Great if you have dry skin and dark spots. Terrible for acne-prone skin.

avis.titre: I WOULD LOVE TO BUY THIS PRODUCT AGAIN!!
avis.texte: ROSEN's Honey + Kojic Illuminating Face Wash is a skincare product designed to brighten and cleanse the skin. Infused with honey and kojic acid, this face wash aims to provide hydration while targeting dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and dullness. The formula is advertised as clean and minimal, making it suitable for various skin types. Pros ✔ Brightening Formula – Kojic acid is a well-known ingredient for reducing dark spots and evening out skin tone. With regular use, this face wash can help achieve a more radiant complexion. ✔ Hydrating & Gentle – Honey is a natural humectant, meaning it helps the skin retain moisture. This makes the face wash ideal for those who need a balance between cleansing and hydration. ✔ Minimalist & Clean Ingredients – Free from harsh chemicals, making it a great option for those who prefer natural skincare. ✔ Eco-Friendly & Sustainable – The brand emphasizes sustainability, which is a plus for conscious consumers.

I've been using the ROSEN Honey Kojic Cleanser, and I have to say—this is a game-changer for anyone looking for a gentle yet effective brightening cleanser. The combination of honey and kojic acid makes it a powerhouse for fading dark spots while keeping the skin hydrated. Unlike some kojic-based products that can be drying, this one feels nourishing and soothing, thanks to the honey. The texture is smooth, and it lathers just enough without stripping the skin. After consistent use, I noticed my complexion looking more even and radiant. It's also great for sensitive skin, as it doesn't cause irritation or that tight, dry feeling. If you're looking for a natural, effective cleanser that helps with hyperpigmentation while keeping your skin soft, I'd definitely recommend giving this one a try!
